source_policy: 同位置实拍优先；缺少同位置支持的路面直接采用经原照片核验的相似高斯路块，保留源块，三维材质来源标检索推断
source_selection: 来源充分/清晰/无车影的多尺度路块检索；实际高斯与原照片的RGB、HF、coverage资格；不按scene/raw或手工目标坐标选择donor
source_parameters: current ordinary-Gaussian asset: XYZ,normal,sigma,rotation,RGB,opacity and source IDs
mapping: each patch locally rigid; robust existing-road normals+height median define target frame; centers=R(source-center)+target-center; covariance=R Sigma R^T; no micro-triangle stretch
assembly: overlapping metric patches, mean unary/Potts local label ownership, no RGB averaging; target old kernel core retires, border optical-depth ownership; actual K visibility peeling plus changed-pixel footprint guard
prior_diagnostic: road_gaussian_transfer_20261122_r1 raw triangle-Jacobian transport retained as zero-update diagnostic; not primary method
reference_bank_role: 199 original frames reused for BUILD; no held-out claim

fit.material_parameters: 4 total: one shared new-kernel RGB gain[.85,1.15] and RGB bias[-.02,.02]
fit.geometry_parameters: new seam opacity[.0001,.999], shared multiplier for each seam kernel tangent sigmas[.9,1.15]; all new core opacity/sigma, all means/normals/normal sigma/rotation and all old fields frozen
fit.loss: current road RGB/alpha against actual observed A and qualified same-position witnesses; independent relu(.99-alpha)^2 on fixed transferred certified domain; small exposure/kernel fidelity priors
fit.normalizers: frozen from the zero-step asset; masks frozen before fitting

source_provenance: every new row records source asset/row ID, patch ID, source/target coordinates, rigid map, ownership, and fit delta; never marks relocated material as same-position observation
validation: original source photo vs isolated native source patch
smoke: real native full lifecycle, discarded updates separate; expected formal400 runtime below1hour, use short complete lifecycle rather than claim10minute long-run qualification
